Thanks for the quick trial sign-up — I'm Marta on the onboarding team at SignalShop (we're the e‑commerce search layer). We're seeing some promising toy results, but would like a brief onboarding/demo to align on production fit and traffic expectations before booking the POC. Quick context:

- Estimated monthly traffic: ~1.2–1.8M text generation tokens + ~300k embedding requests (roughly 80% embedding traffic).

- Timeline: aiming for PoC within 3–6 weeks and production by Q4.

I've attached a small traffic snapshot and a rough arch diagram. Can we book a 30–45 minute call next week? We're CET (UTC+1); afternoon CET works best for us.

Thanks,

Hi Marta — welcome and thanks for the details + attachments. Happy to run a short onramp and cover both product fit and what a PoC would look like. A few quick qualification questions so we can tailor the session and bring the right folks: 

1) Concurrency / spikes: what peak QPS or concurrent requests do you see (p95/p99 day)? Is traffic bursty (campaign-driven) or steady?
2) Indexing cadence: are you calculating embeddings offline into a vector DB (batch) or doing real‑time embedding on every new product/query?
3) Latency SLOs: what's your 95th/99th latency target for search and for generation flows?
4) Security: any special compliance needs (PII redaction, SOC2 evidence requests) we should prep for the PoC?
5) Example prompt set: if you can share 10 representative queries (anonymized) that helps us reproduce relevance issues during the demo.

Proposed times (our Calendly link below covers availability; pick one and we'll lock a calendar invite and include a Solutions Engineer for the technical bits):
- Tue Jul 12, 14:00–14:45 CET (13:00–13:45 UTC)
- Wed Jul 13, 16:00–16:45 CET
- Thu Jul 14, 09:00–09:45 CET (we can do an earlier technical deep-dive if needed)

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/onramp-30m

Looping in Karthik and Ben to join the call — Karthik will run the tech deep-dive; Ben will cover trial logistics and success metrics. If you prefer a standalone technical hour, we can lengthen the slot.

Best,
Irene Choi
SDR, Redwood Inference

Irene — quick notes to sync before the invite goes out: 

- Ask them to attach a 24h traffic histogram (UTC buckets) and a sample of the 10 prompts (anonymized). That helps us size batching + KV cache behavior.
- For embeddings: confirm vector dim (we've seen 768/1,024 frequently) and whether they use incremental index updates (rolling) vs full reindexes. If it's incremental, caching strategy differs.
- Bring SE (Sam R.) for the trace-level discussion on cold starts and prefix caching; propose adding a 60-minute technical slot if they indicate high concurrency (p99 > 200ms target).
- Proposed default: lock Tue Jul 12 14:00 CET. If Marta confirms CET afternoon, we keep that.

I'll forward a short pre-demo checklist doc after we get the 10 prompts and histogram.
